examples.english: If you buy your plane ticket early, you can sometimes get it much cheaper.

notes:
{航空券|こうくうけん} is the standard formal term for an airline ticket. In casual speech, ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧ is more common, but {航空券|こうくうけん} is used in official contexts such as booking confirmations, travel agencies, and airport announcements.

ETYMOLOGY:
A compound of ⟦{航空|こうくう}→航空：02798_koukuu⟧ (aviation) + ⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧ (ticket). The ⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧ suffix appears in many ticket-related words such as ⟦{乗車券|じょうしゃけん}→乗車券：05298_joushaken⟧ (train ticket) and ⟦{入場券|にゅうじょうけん}→入場券：19454_nyuujouken⟧ (admission ticket).

- {航空券|こうくうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}する→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧: to book a plane ticket
- {航空券|こうくうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to purchase a plane ticket
